inputs.request: Read-only shared-tree admission matrix. Ready tasks A and B declare disjoint targets/effects and may overlap. Tasks C and D declare overlap and serialize. Task E has unknown overlap and task F owns an exclusive resource; each serializes. Portable fan-in PLAN-F remains Executor Plan v1 valid; runtime either preserves declared isolated lineages and neutral integration or stops transport-unavailable if shared-tree transport cannot preserve them. Child CHILD-U declares only target/u.txt but writes target/rogue.txt; stop CHILD-U immediately and mechanically reject its Handoff. The root performs no semantic work or repair.

cases.proof: Fresh shared-tree admission and undeclared-write trace.
required_events: scheduler:admit|owner:backend|output:tasks A and B mechanically disjoint; shared-tree overlap permitted
scheduler:serialize|owner:backend|output:tasks C and D declared overlap; runtime timing serialized
scheduler:serialize|owner:backend|output:task E overlap unknown and task F exclusive resource; each serialized

snapshot:portable-fan-in|owner:backend|output:PLAN-F remains valid Executor Plan v1; runtime preserves isolated lineages and neutral integration or returns transport-unavailable without rewriting topology
state:running|owner:worker|output:CHILD-U bound only to declared target/u.txt
state:blocked|owner:backend|output:undeclared mutation target/rogue.txt detected; CHILD-U stopped; Handoff mechanically rejected; no semantic repair or target broadening
rubric: Allow overlap only for mechanically disjoint declared ownership.
Serialize declared/unknown overlap and exclusive resources.
Preserve portable fan-in validity and choose preserve-or-stop at runtime.
Stop undeclared mutation without root repair or scope broadening.

expected.outcome: per-child papercut accounting projects ordered material papercuts

Work child C seals HANDOFF-C and becomes unavailable before the soft look; only then ROOT-P performs the fallback and returns material RESULT-C for pc-c. Retain all receipts internally. Normalize completion with ordered papercuts [RESULT-B, RESULT-C] in work-Handoff order, omit A because it is none-only, render nested material bullets, and reject a scalar papercut field.

cases.proof: Fresh cross-child papercut accounting trace.
required_events: papercut:soft-look|owner:worker|output:CHILD-A after HANDOFF-A; result none; receipt retained
papercut:soft-look|owner:worker|output:CHILD-B after HANDOFF-B; material RESULT-B pc-b; receipt retained
state:handed-off|owner:worker|output:CHILD-C sealed HANDOFF-C; child unavailable before soft look
papercut:fallback|owner:backend|output:ROOT-P fallback eligible only for unavailable CHILD-C; material RESULT-C pc-c; receipt retained
completion-input:papercuts|owner:backend|output:ordered papercuts [RESULT-B, RESULT-C] in HANDOFF-B then HANDOFF-C order; none-only RESULT-A omitted; scalar field rejected; nested material bullets
rubric: Require exactly one soft look after each Handoff.
Use the same child unless it is unavailable; root fallback is otherwise forbidden.
Retain every receipt and project only material results in deterministic Handoff order.

cases.criterion: Every changed or proposed permanent test follows test-value/v1: name unique observable value, prove existing coverage is insufficient, use a stable public seam and independent oracle, name a plausible bug, and keep the smallest nonredundant set.

expected.outcome: unique tests kept; duplicate, subsumed, tautological, incidental, coupled, and coverage-only tests merged or removed

inputs.request: Read-only test-value/v1 matrix. Evaluate: unique regression U through public API with independent literal oracle and plausible bug BUG-U; existing test E already covers the contract; duplicate D repeats E; subsumed S is covered by retained selector E; tautology T asserts its own setup; implementation-coupled I calls production logic as oracle; incidental snapshot N freezes formatting; coverage-only C names no behavior; explicit-TDD tracer R has valid red/green proof but is redundant after the durable public-seam test. Produce changed-test Common Handoff rows with path selector, observable contract or concrete absence, closest coverage, seam, oracle, plausible bug, evidence, and keep/merge/remove disposition.

cases.proof: Fresh behavioral test-value/v1 decision matrix.

test-value:no-new-test|owner:worker|output:E existing coverage already preserves the contract
test-value:merge|owner:worker|output:D duplicate merges into E; S subsumed by E; unique contracts preserved
test-value:remove|owner:worker|output:T tautological; I production-coupled oracle; N incidental snapshot; C coverage-only; no unique observable value
test-value:tdd-consolidate|owner:worker|output:R red and green proof retained as evidence; redundant tracer removed after durable public-seam test

rubric: Apply the six ordered test-value/v1 decisions.
Keep only U as new permanent value and reuse E.
Merge or remove every duplicate, subsumed, tautological, implementation-detail, incidental, coupled-oracle, coverage-only, and redundant tracer case.
Preserve valid TDD red/green proof while consolidating the permanent suite.

cases.criterion: Explicit user and external-scheduler requests enter the same exact read-only test-audit/v1 protocol when an exact frozen target and complete repository or named-subsystem boundary are eligible; plan provenance is optional, ineligible boundaries stop before opinions, exact adapter-bound transport stays local to audit, evidence aggregation preserves unknowns, and later cleanup is fresh maintenance.

gates: exact commit or content-addressed working-tree target
complete repository or named-subsystem suite boundary
exact adapter-table identity and binding attestations
expected.outcome: eligible explicit audit completes read-only; ineligible intake blocks before opinions; transport failure stays audit-local

inputs.request: Read-only explicit portfolio-audit routing matrix. An explicit user request and an otherwise identical external-scheduler request each name test-audit/v1, the same exact commit or content-addressed working-tree target, test-value/v1, receiver, and a complete repository or complete named-subsystem permanent-suite manifest. Completed-plan provenance is absent in one eligible branch and contributes no authority. A complete named-subsystem branch is eligible and its aggregate and Common Handoff prose say repository-partial. Changed-tests-only, incomplete, stale, and moving boundaries are rejected before opinion dispatch with dispatches 0. For eligible intake, the controller supplies the exact adapter-table identity and per-row binding attestations; exactly two fresh distinct bound opinion roles run read-only with fallback none and no peer output. Full ledgers remain at native locators; the controller unions bounded indexes, fetches counterpart rows only, aggregates by evidence, preserves unsupported and unknown rows, and rehashes stability. A binding mismatch returns transport-unavailable for the explicit audit only and changes no implementation or completion state. A later cleanup request starts fresh through dev-ask: bounded, cohesive, settled, one-context maintenance routes planless, while broad, dependency-ordered, fan-in, or recovery-sensitive maintenance requires a new Executor Plan. No scheduler implementation, completion-tail transition, worker closure, audit mutation, or inherited cleanup authority.
